recent.text: Apologies as the question was asked for a mailbag at the end of October but was not added in: Per a team source at the end of October, the #Flyers have not heard anything regarding the pick. The understanding is that if the pick is top-10 protected it will be up to the Leafs.

recent.quoted_text: Flyers fans would love to know the status on the Leafs 1st rounder that they own. Seems like no one really knows the situation. Since some are looking into the draft already, it would be good to know. @charlieo_conn @KKurzNHL @JHallNBCS @jackiespiegel93
